review.description: Compared receive-notifications specification and catalog contract with main; authored scenarios and dependency ownership are unchanged. The change is limited to contributor verification: complete Python suite inventories run in two bounded worker processes; fixture behavior and acceptance thresholds remain unchanged. Current comparison remains main5097e2a7. Contributor verification now uses authenticated enclosing-group admission, real-case rediscovery and explicit ordinary fixture/import skip accounting; product meanings, interface ownership, historical adoption and acceptance thresholds are unchanged. Incoming plugin API v2 product/foundation changes are preserved as current target behavior; this PR adds only contributor verification changes.

The incoming target entry is preserved byte-for-byte, while tooling commands select complete current inventories.
review.tests: Inspected actual assertions at internal/events/events_test.go / func TestSubscriptionVerificationRetryDedupRefreshAndExpiry( for scenarios S1, S2. The subscription fixture recomputes the signature over actual delivered bytes and checks it against the webhook-signature header; its declared filtering/retry/expiry assertions and explicit untested failure classes remain unchanged. Other mapped assertions and declared gaps are preserved; all required catalog suites remain selected. No fixture result establishes installed-host acceptance.
